specs.title: Dropdown keyboard navigation skips disabled actions, opens submenus and returns focus
Dropdown cancels selection, changes preferences and keeps live accessible IDs
Dropdown Tab leaves naturally, native links navigate and outside pointer does not steal focus
Dropdown hover opens a child without stealing focus and closes it when another action receives focus
Context Menu positions at the pointer and supports keyboard invocation and nested commands
Menubar roves across enabled triggers and changes an open menu in LTR and RTL
Navigation hover and keyboard expose native links in a shared viewport
Command searches keywords, handles empty results and executes only an enabled selection
Command dialog and dropdown inside a modal close independently and restore native focus
Menus light enlarged mobile layouts and accessibility
